algorithmic_observations_and_followups: The BIGINT lookup_hash chunk is about 8.003 compressed bytes per row and comprises 70.6% of this fixture’s active Parquet bytes; it is a material fixed-width per-row cost.

source_position is populated redundantly from id here (about 1.02 bytes per row compressed). The native-source contract permits null positions; use null when the accepted source profile does not supply a position rather than copying id. Confirm with real accepted feed semantics before estimating savings.

The fixture stores decimal string(id) as source_delivery_id (about 0.38 bytes per row). Actual source delivery identifiers are opaque and their storage cost remains unknown. Do not convert their declared string type based on this synthetic sample.

The next writer investigation should focus on the edge-write path because it is slower and scales less efficiently in this sample; inspect the production writer’s repartition/serialization path and accepted edge payload before proposing a tuning change. Avoid extrapolating a core multiplier or running a platform matrix.
